source.description: PROBLEM: bd/beads workflow guidance is scattered — using-xtrm skill lacks deeper bd-management patterns, CLAUDE.md's managed bd instructions could be tightened, and useful excerpts from the planning skill (issue decomposition, dependency graph shaping) aren't cross-referenced where orchestrators need them mid-session. SUCCESS: using-xtrm SKILL.md gains concrete bd-management trigger patterns beyond the current table; CLAUDE.md managed bd section is reviewed and tightened for clarity/accuracy; relevant planning-skill excerpts (or pointers) are folded in where they'd help an orchestrator mid-task rather than only at planning time; evaluate whether using-xtrm should be reshaped further (e.g. split, reorganize) once the above additions land. SCRUTINY: none SCOPE: .claude/skills/using-xtrm/SKILL.md (or its canonical xtrm-tools package source), CLAUDE.md bd-management sections, .claude/skills/planning/SKILL.md (read for excerpting only). NON_GOALS: no change to bd/sp binaries; no change to using-specialists-v3 (tracked separately). CONSTRAINTS: doc-only; preserve using-xtrm's terse behavioral-manual style — do not turn it into a full command reference (that stays in CLAUDE.md). VALIDATION: reread edited sections for internal consistency and cross-reference correctness. OUTPUT: diff(s) to the edited skill/doc files, plus an explicit reshape recommendation (keep as-is / split / reorganize) with rationale.
source.title: Improve bd management guidance: using-xtrm additions, CLAUDE.md edits, planning-skill excerpts
